pre_install_audit: recorded in narration-capability-audit.json: no TTS anywhere, no speech lane, AUDIO_RENDER unable to express draft fidelity

installation.method: bounded venv, no global environment mutation
installation.note: installed outside the repository on purpose; binaries and models are not committed

voice.selection_reason: one neutral English voice, clear and fast; a library of voices was not installed and Mikko was not cloned

audio_standard.conversion: ffmpeg, with both provider-raw and normalized hashes recorded so the conversion is auditable

typed_evidence.not_audio_render: AUDIO_RENDER was deliberately not reused: it requires state PRODUCTION_READY, has no fidelity field, and attributes to sound_music_director

gate8.note: narration clears the audio blocker and nothing else. PROXY_CAPTURE_READY is not claimed, because a voice is not a presenter.

negative_proofs.production_mode: proxy readiness not applicable; evidence.satisfies_real_capture false; regeneration refused
negative_proofs.empty_text: NARRATION_TEXT_EMPTY (a silent beat is declared, never synthesized)

consumability.scorecraft: manifest exposes measured assembled duration, a run-relative path, and contiguous per-beat start/end seconds — the ducking and timing inputs. Scorecraft composition logic was not modified.
consumability.edit: narration is discoverable by convention at media/draft-narration/narration.wav with a manifest beside it. No automatic edit ingestion exists yet; recorded as a downstream gap rather than expanded into.

qc_integration.reason: scripts/qc-director.js is being modified by another session (mode-aware QC applicability), so DRAFT_SYNTHETIC_NARRATION was NOT added to its SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE_KINDS
qc_integration.mitigation: the evidence is self-describing — kind, fidelity, satisfies_real_capture, human_authority_required, does_not_assert — so the QC policy can consume it without this module knowing about QC

next_capability.name: PROXY_PRESENTER
next_capability.why_not_now: no producer exists, and fabricating a blank or still-image video would be exactly the fake evidence the contract forbids

contract.input: canonical Story beats plus the narration manifest beat timing
contract.output: generated visual media with real bytes, per beat or continuous
contract.media_type: PROXY_PRESENTER, a distinct artifact type — NOT a new fidelity class on PRESENTER_A_ROLL, which stays capture-class by design
contract.duration_alignment: must cover the narration duration, per beat
contract.coverage: every spoken beat, with deliberate absence declared
contract.provenance: engine, model, settings, byte hashes, DRAFT fidelity
